meaning.zh:
“讨好分” 或 “额外的表扬”。

“Brownie points” 源于八十多年前 Boy Scouts （男童子军）和 Girl Scouts （女童子军）中的一系列奖励积分系统。这个短语用来描述一个人为获得他人 (尤其是上司或老师) 的认可和表扬而做出的额外努力。
meaning.en: This phrase originates from the scoring system used in the Boy Scouts and Girl Scouts over eighty years ago. It is commonly used to describe extra effort made to gain approval or praise from someone in authority, like a boss or teacher.

lines.en: He brought coffee for everyone in the office to earn some *Brownie points* with the boss.
lines.zh: 他给办公室每个人买了咖啡来讨好老板。

lines.en: She stayed late to finish the project and scored major *Brownie points* with the manager.
lines.zh: 她为了完成项目而加班，得到了经理的高度赞赏。

lines.en: Helping out with the charity event will earn you some *Brownie points* with the community.
lines.zh: 帮助慈善活动会让你在社区中获得一些额外的表扬。
